`defineExtensionConfigSchema` is implemented in `openmrs-esm-core` and called from four modules in the patient chart. A change to its behaviour (validation, schema merging with `implicitConfigSchema`, the duplicate-name warning, or how the store is updated) would reach the chart through `startupApp()` registration. The chart's call sites don't depend on the return value, so the risk is in what gets stored and validated.

**Chart call sites (directly affected)**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/index.ts` registers `patient-flags-risk-count` and `patient-flags-list` in `startupApp()`.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/index.ts` registers `obs-by-encounter-widget` and `obs-table-horizontal-widget`.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/index.ts` registers `person-attribute-tag`.

**Chart schemas passed in (the shapes that would be validated or merged)**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/config-schema-obs-switchable.ts` (`configSchemaSwitchable`, uses `validators.oneOf` and nested `_elements`)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/config-schema-obs-horizontal.ts` (`configSchemaHorizontal`, uses `validators.inRange`)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/flags/flags-risk-count-extension/extension-config-schema.ts` (`riskCountExtensionConfigSchema`, default `['patient-summary']`)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/flags/flags-list-extension/extension-config-schema.ts` (`flagsListExtensionConfigSchema`)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/person-attribute-tags.extension.tsx` (`personAttributeTagsExtensionConfigSchema`)

**Core definition and framework consumers**
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts` is the implementation (validates, merges with `implicitConfigSchema`, warns on duplicates, writes to the store).
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/public.ts` re-exports it.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/index.ts` is the other production caller.

**Test mocks and tests in core (would drift from real behaviour)**
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/mock.ts` and `mock-jest.ts` are no-op or simplified stand-ins.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/storybook/mocks/esm-config.ts` is an empty stub.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/extensions.test.tsx`, `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.test.ts`, and `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/src/integration-tests/extension-recomputation.test.tsx` exercise the real function.

I did not open the chart components that read these configs with `useConfig` (for example `PersonAttributeTags`). They would be affected by changed config values rather than by the call itself, so I left them out of the list. The line ranges for the core mocks and tests are single-line call or declaration sites, not full function bodies.
